title: Vector quickstart illustration and screenshot kit for embeddings + rerank
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Deliver a coherent, production-ready asset pack for the Embeddings + Re-ranking quickstart that can be embedded in docs, used in the Console onboarding modal, and included in the public SDK quickstart. Assets should include a storyboard-style vector pipeline illustration (multi-size), annotated responsive screenshots showing the Console 'Create index -> Upload -> Embed -> Rerank' flow, and three sample output card variants (short, detailed, explainability). Keep visuals generic — no customer PII, anonymize sample data. Provide Figma file with tokens, export-ready SVG/PNG assets, and a short handoff README for engineers.
acceptance_criteria: Figma file with labeled frames and componentized pipeline illustration exported to SVG and 2x PNG
Pipeline storyboard with 3 responsive sizes (mobile/tablet/desktop) and accessible color contrast
3 screenshot comps with callouts: (1) Create index modal, (2) Batch upload + embedding progress, (3) Query + rerank results with tokenized sample output
Sample output cards: short (1-2 sentences), medium (bulleted highlights + score), long (explainability overlay) — all anonymized
Copy snippets for docs: 150–250 word quickstart intro, 3 inline API examples (curl/JS/Python) with placeholder tokens
Handoff README in Figma linking to PRD, sample data policy, and engineering API examples (links to GH PR and docs page)
Sign-off from PM and Eng with privacy confirmation and latency number guidance added to callouts
